text:
262 African American students enrolled at Pleasantview Elementary School in 2024-25
Pleasantview Elementary School enrolled 262 African American students in the 2024-25 school year, an increase of 18.6% from the previous year, according to the Michigan Department of Education.
Pleasantview Elementary had 311 students during the 2024-25 school year. African American students made up 84.2% of the student body, the largest represented ethnicity at the school.
The school is in Eastpointe Community Schools District, whose central office is in Eastpointe.
Among the eight schools in Eastpointe Community Schools District, Eastpointe High School had the highest enrollment of African American students in the 2024-25 school year.
In the 2025-26 school year, over 1.41 million students were enrolled in Michigan schools, about 5.3% fewer than the nearly 1.45 million recorded before the pandemic in the 2019-20 school year. White student enrollment experienced the largest decline, falling about 5.8%.
